steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: ♪Night blankets the riverbanks♪

steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: ♪Twin moons rise in loving embrace♪

steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: ♪In the dark they kiss♪

steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: ♪Then the stars illuminate♪

steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: ♪And they blush in their glow♪

steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: You gave me a fright, girl! What are you doing here in the middle of the night?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Scared I'm gonna rob you?

steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: Of course not. It's only rich folks around here.

steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: Shouldn't a girl your age be on a date down at Riverside Avenue at this hour? What are you doing in front of the museum?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I'm on the night shift.

steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: Ugh, the youth these days! My lamps used to shine on young couples in the throes of passion, but now you're all doing overtime at ungodly hours.

steps.name: Lamplighter
steps.text: Go on, I've lit your path. Have a safe trip home when you get off.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Thanks for that!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: There really is no one here... guess Titi wasn't messing with me.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Let's see if they've picked up anything new.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Gem workshop artifacts from the Age of Shadow. Hmm... The Originium circuits on this one is really something... assembled from multiple pieces?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: No, it was crafted out of a single piece of Originium. Amazing work. Really have to look close to see it.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Wow, ritual instruments from the Age of Flow, found in the jungles. Are those blood spots from ritual sacrifices?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: And all these weapons... A ceremony from the Battle of Turbah Al-Sawda?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Well, I'll get to know you later. I have an appointment to keep.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: It's here...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Nice to meet you, old man! Sorry for disturbing your peace and quiet tonight, but I have questions that only you can answer.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Please don't get mad at me.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Wow, amazing!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Feline, approximately two meters tall. Most of the body has been replaced with mechanical parts, integrated with the remaining biological tissue.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Skin color is purple, likely from the preservative fluids used, and it remains supple to the touch.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: A golden mask and a suit of golden armor. All internal organs have been removed.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Strange. Neither the mummy nor the funerary objects give any clue to the location of the trove.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: But everything from the site is here.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Perhaps it's the gem itself that offers a hint...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: 'First, the heart. At its first beat, we come to be.'

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: 'Second, the lungs. At their first breath, we come to feel.'

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: 'Third, the bowels. We fill them with food, cultivate our tongues, and develop our own likings.'

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: 'Fourth, the liver. We go into the night, awake and alert, for duty and obligation.'

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Now how do I use this gem?
Pepe ponders for a while, then reaches into the mummy's chest cavity, placing the gem where the heart should be.
She holds her breath, waiting for something to happen.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Nothing?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: No change at all...
No images or text appear. Pepe frowns and tries to retrieve the gem.
Perhaps she simply placed it wrong.
But as soon as she reaches into the chest cavity, she senses that something is off.
There should be an empty space, but it feels like she's put her hand into water. The gem is right there before her eyes, but she feels like she's groping in a bottomless pond.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Huh...
Who goes there? Have you any idea what time it is?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Oh no, it's security.
Pepe closes the glass display case lightly, and sneaks into the darkness, holding her breath.

steps.name: Museum Security
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Museum Security
steps.text: I thought I heard something.

steps.name: Museum Security
steps.text: Was it over here?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Don't come this way, no!)

steps.name: Museum Security
steps.text: Hey, is someone there?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Yikes! He's right behind me...)

steps.name: Museum Security
steps.text: Who is it?!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (There's someone else?)

steps.name: Mysterious Animal
steps.text: Meow?

steps.name: Museum Security
steps.text: Oh, just a little critter. How did you get in here, cutie?

steps.name: Mysterious Animal
steps.text: Meow!

steps.name: Museum Security
steps.text: Hey, don't run! Look, I have a can of fins in oil!

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (I need to get the gem...)

steps.name: Museum Security
steps.text: Where did it go? I just turned a corner and it's gone?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Why are you coming back?!)

steps.name: Museum Security
steps.text: Did the last shift forget to shut the windows? Hot air's blowing in.

steps.name: Museum Security
steps.text: I guess that explains the critter. Can't let it run around the museum.

steps.name: Mysterious Animal
steps.text: Mroaw—!

steps.name: Mysterious Animal
steps.text: Mroaaaw—!

steps.name: Angry Woman
steps.text: I don't care whose pet you are, one more sound from you and I'll have you castrated tomorrow!

steps.name: Mysterious Animal
steps.text: (Softly) Meow...?

steps.name: Slumbering Citizen
steps.text: *yawn* Sorry, Mio, I was fast asleep and didn't hear you outside.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Shakes tail irritably)

steps.name: Slumbering Citizen
steps.text: Did you see that one?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Slumbering Citizen
steps.text: Good work, Mio.

steps.name: Slumbering Citizen
steps.text: We've waited for so long.

steps.name: Slumbering Citizen
steps.text: Bring him to me as soon as you can.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Slumbering Citizen
steps.text: Come, I have some jerky for you.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Nudges with affection)
Pepe...
What were you doing last night?
Come now... You have to tell me...

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I-It wasn't me! I didn't do it! I stayed in the whole night! Whatever it is, I didn't do it!

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Pepe...?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Anat...?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Pepe, did you... sleep last night?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Why do you ask? I feel fine.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: You fell asleep in the middle of a conversation...
*yawn*... Morning, ladies.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: You reek of alcohol, Titi. Where were you last night?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: I took Pepe out on the town. Not like she's in town every day, after all.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: How did you even wake up after drinking so much yesterday? And not one whiff of booze on you? Did you shower?

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Oh... yeah! My brain was all foggy, so I took a cold shower.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: The opening ceremony is today, Titi.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: And you took Pepe out drinking??? Don't I have enough to worry about already?!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Hey, I came first thing in the morning. I've looked at all the details of the exhibition. Your arrangements are perfect, except...

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Is something not good enough? Just tell me, while we still have a chance to make changes.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: You're too high strung today. Settle down.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Just focus on your speech. Leave this to me, and I guarantee your exhibition will go smoothly.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: *sigh* Get changed before you make any promise to me. The guests will complain if they smell all that liquor on you.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: (Whisper) That look on your face. What trouble did you get yourself into? Explain.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Whisper) I tried putting that gem into the mummy's chest cavity last night. I was about to retrieve it when a security guard showed up.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Whisper) Get me a bit of time alone with the mummy once the exhibition is over. I'll take the gem back.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: (Whisper) Thankfully, no one has noticed anything wrong. You'll have an hour, at most. If you still can't get it out, I'll have to report that my pass got stolen.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Whisper) Don't worry, if I can't get it out, I'll apologize to Anat my self.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: (Whisper) How did you get that smell onto you anyway?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: (Whisper) I poured a bottle of wine on myself before I came in.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Explains why you're all sticky.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: How are preparations going over there, Ajani?

steps.name: Right Earphone
steps.text: No problem, Narantuya. The smoke emitter is set, and we'll have our commotion on your signal.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Your status, Ajazi?

steps.name: Left Earphone
steps.text: I'm in position.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Good. She's a Padishah's daughter, and there will be big trouble if we don't make this a clean kidnapping.

steps.name: Left Earphone
steps.text: I don't understand why you insist on doing it here with all these visitors around.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: The more people, the better.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: When the commotion happens, no one will bat an eye at a few compassionate souls carrying a poor fainted girl out of the room.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: They'll be too busy worrying about themselves.

steps.name: Right Earphone
steps.text: I marked the camera blind spots on your map. Pick the right time to knock her out.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Right, I'll leave early to set an ambush.

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Hopefully this needle will give her a good dream. I don't want to have to go into the jungle to make this serum again.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: I can't read the hieroglyphs on the sign... excuse me. Do you know how to get to the 'Northeastern Tributary' exhibit?

steps.name: Picky Visitor
steps.text: The Northeastern Tributary exhibit, huh...? I'm not sure. I've never been there.

steps.name: Picky Visitor
steps.text: We could look for it together, if you don't mind. I find the lines of your muscles more beautiful than anything on display here.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Please don't say that. Everything exhibited here is a piece of history.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: All these artifacts are worth stopping to admire.

steps.name: Picky Visitor
steps.text: You could have just said you weren't interested and spared me the excuses.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Excuse me. Do you know where the Northeastern Tributary exhibit is?

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Let's see... take a right there, walk five hundred meters, then take a left.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Thank you. I've asked quite a few people, but none of them knew where it was.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: I understand. The citizens here are proud of Sargon's long history, but they don't care much about faraway places.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: You should have seen when the Columbian history exhibit was running. So quiet you could hear a pin drop.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Yes... I can sense the arrogance.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Thank you for showing me the way.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Respect... that's what modern people lack.

steps.name: Wandering Staff
steps.text: Wait, how did I end up in this hall again? I should try the right side this time.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: There are more visitors than I expected.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: I'm a little worried about Anat. She's fidgeting so much she's going to tear her speech to shreds.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Can't be any worse than her first presentation. It took hours for her to come back to her senses that time.

steps.name: Pepe
steps.text: Hey, where are you going?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Just to have a little chat with her, get her to relax.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: How are the preparations going, Anat?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: I can already recite this speech backwards from memory, but the moment I think about all those eyes fixed on me, listening to every word I say...

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: What will they think if I stutter, or make a mistake?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: They'll all forget by dinner.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: The Flood Festival is right around the corner. Who has room to remember one girl's embarrassment during all those festivities?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: But I'm nervo—hey, why are you rubbing my ears?

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Feel better now?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Works every time. I still remember how Pepe and I rubbed your ears like this for an entire day to get you to relax before an interview.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: ...Thank you, Titi. Very thoughtful.

steps.name: MC
steps.text: Bayanlar ve Baylar, take your seats, and welcome Curator Anat El-Aydin onto the stage with a round of warm applause!

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: Go. It's alright if you make a mistake, just keep going.

steps.name: Medjehtiqedti
steps.text: If you're so stiff, I'll sneak around behind your back and rub your ears. Better to be embarrassed together than alone, right?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Oh, Titi...

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Welcome to the Varjavandabad Museum's special exhibit, commemorating the Flood Festival.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: The highlight of the exhibit is an unnamed man, discovered in the Fourth Necropolis Complex on the outskirts of the city, meeting the public for the first time.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Both the body, the armor and the funerary objects buried with him are remarkably well-preserved.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: The extraordinary details on his clothing is clear indication of high status.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: It has been dated to the early days of the New Calendar according to the Aslan dating method, making him a contemporary of Lugalszargus, the 'Shah of Past and Future'.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: He has not been identified in any extant Sargonian historical records. Based on the artifacts recovered from his tomb, we theorize that he may have been...

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Excuse me, is this the Northeastern Tributary exhibit?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Did I take a wrong turn?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Yes... the Northeastern Tributary exhibit is on the other side of the museum, near the entrance.

steps.name: Aspasia
steps.text: Sorry to interrupt.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: ...It's fine.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Ahem... in any case... Continuing where we left off...

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: We have theorized that the mummy is...

steps.name: Man in Pain
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Excuse me, sir! Sorry!

steps.name: Man in Pain
steps.text: Are you blind?!

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Honored guests...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: My fault! Sorry, sir!

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Excuse me, hanimefendi... where are you going?

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Urgent business! Please carry on speaking!

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: But I'm just reaching...

steps.name: Narantuya
steps.text: Alright, yes! I know, I'm getting out right now.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: ...the most important part of the presentation.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Er... where was I...?

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Sorry... let me find my place...

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Oh, yes... the exhibit behind me...

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: I-It's...

steps.name: Voice in the Crowd
steps.text: *yawn*

steps.name: Voice in the Crowd
steps.text: What is she talking about? I'm getting sleepy...

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: It's...
Anat spent a long time preparing for this speech.
She prepared for bored audience members to leave, or heckle her for her mistakes.
But she never imagined she would lose her train of thought because an interruption, leaving her speechless.
She tries to collect herself, taking a few deep breaths, forcing a smile toward the crowd. She attempts to continue.
Then she feels a hand on her ear, pressing it gently.
Anat blinks, feeling a sense of warmth rise in her heart.

steps.name: Anat
steps.text: Thanks, Titi. I'm fine, don't wor—
Anat does not finish the sentence.
She sees Titi looking up at her from the crowd in terror. Pepe's jaw has dropped open so wide that it could fit a whole apple.
If Titi is not behind her, then whose hand is on her ear?
Anat gulps. She dares not turn around.
